shellCommands.command: (npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- streaming order (timestamps) ---"; curl -sN --no-buffer http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o 'Premium Widget\|Checking availability\|[0-9]* in stock' | while read -r l; do printf '%s  %s\n' "$(date +%S.%N | cut -c1-6)" "$l"; done

cd /workspace; echo "--- freshness (2 requests) ---"; for i in 1 2; do curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '[0-9]\+ in stock' | head -1; done; echo "--- client-nav prefetch payload ---"; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/pf.txt -w 'status=%{http_code}\n'; grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.txt; grep -o 'Checking availability' /tmp/pf.txt | head -1; grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.txt

cd /workspace; echo "--- freshness ---"; for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s http://localhost:3111/product | grep -o '[0-9]\+<!-- --> in stock'; done; echo "--- 307 location ---"; curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product | grep -i '^location\|^HTTP\|^x-nextjs'

cd /workspace; curl -sL -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product -o /tmp/pf.txt -w 'status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n'; echo "title in prefetch: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "fallback in prefetch: $(grep -c 'Checking availability' /tmp/pf.txt)"; echo "inventory in prefetch: $(grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.txt)"

cd /workspace; U=$(curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' http://localhost:3111/product | grep -i '^location' | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}'); echo "url=$U"; curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' "http://localhost:3111$U" -o /tmp/pf.txt -w 'status=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n'; echo "title: $(grep -c 'Premium Widget' /tmp/pf.txt)  fallback: $(grep -c 'Checking availability' /tmp/pf.txt)  inventory: $(grep -c 'in stock' /tmp/pf.txt)"

cd /workspace; pkill -f 'next start' 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; (npx next dev -p 3122 >/tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &); sleep 9; curl -s http://localhost:3122/ -o /dev/null; curl -s http://localhost:3122/product -o /dev/null; sleep 4; echo "=== dev log ==="; cat /tmp/dev.log
nohup npx next dev -p 3123 >/tmp/dev2.log 2>&1 & echo started
cd /workspace; echo "=== AGENTS.md ==="; cat AGENTS.md; echo "=== git status ==="; git status --short

cd /workspace; cp /tmp/fixed.tsx app/product/page.tsx; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:3123/product -o /dev/null -w 'status=%{http_code}\n'; sleep 6; echo "=== insights after fix ==="; grep -c 'blocking-prerender-dynamic' /tmp/dev2.log; echo "(count above includes the deliberate regression test)"; tail -4 /tmp/dev2.log
cd /workspace; pkill -f 'next dev' ; echo "--- .gitignore ---"; cat .gitignore; echo "--- final file ---"; cat app/product/page.tsx; echo "--- tsconfig diff ---"; git diff --stat tsconfig.json
cd /workspace; cat .gitignore; echo "--- diff ---"; git diff --stat
cd /workspace; rm -rf .next; git diff app/product/page.tsx; echo "--- untracked now ---"; git status --short
